discount_codes_value_ck.name: discount_codes_value_ck
discount_codes_value_ck.value: ("discount_codes"."kind" = 'percent' and "discount_codes"."value" between 1 and 100) or ("discount_codes"."kind" = 'fixed' and "discount_codes"."value" between 1 and 1000000000)

discount_codes_dates_ck.name: discount_codes_dates_ck
discount_codes_dates_ck.value: "discount_codes"."starts_at" is null or "discount_codes"."ends_at" is null or "discount_codes"."starts_at" < "discount_codes"."ends_at"

users_contact_ck.name: users_contact_ck
users_contact_ck.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone" is not null
